verdict.rationale: INPI Portugal offers online IP filing services (patents, trademarks, designs), so a test or sandbox environment for programmatic or agent interaction is a fair question for this kind of service. The evidence pack documents only filing procedures and contains no mention of any sandbox, test environment, or developer API. The llms.txt probe returned 404, and that says nothing about sandbox isolation either way.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
